enchantments.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus: +2 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Insightful Command: Passive: +2 Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks. Command armor and command shields make their owners very noticeable, imposing a -6 penalty on Hide checks.
Repair Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming repair healing by +7 (Enhancement bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
